decisions.mark: distinguishes the two ways to substitute an allocator — a COMPILE-time pair of macros versus a RUNTIME pair of function pointers — and states that they are mutually exclusive
decisions.detail: QUOTE: A project can substitute its own allocator at compile time with two macros, or at runtime with `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()`. ... `platform.c:16-22` says the compile-time macros take precedence. When both macros are set, the runtime setter and its pointers are compiled out entirely. | WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter. It also says that when the macros are defined the runtime setter is compiled out, so the two are exclusive. || QUOTE: A project can substitute its own allocator at compile time with two macros, or at runtime with `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()`. ... `platform.c:16-22` says the compile-time macros take precedence. When both macros are set, the runtime setter and its pointers are compiled out entirely. | WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter. It says that defining the macros compiles the runtime setter and pointers out entirely, which makes the two mutually exclusive. || QUOTE: A project can substitute its own allocator at compile time with two macros, or at runtime with `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()`. ... `platform.c:16-22` says the compile-time macros take precedence. It also says that with both macros defined, the runtime setter and its pointers are compiled out, which is mutual exclusion.

So "library uses the facility" means this module is the only in-tree caller of `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` according to the index." | WHY: The answer names the memory buffer allocator, says its init function installs itself via the runtime setter, and calls it the only in-tree caller. decisions.mark: states that the buffer allocator installs a MUTEXED pair when MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is on and a plain pair otherwise, chosen at compile time inside its init function
decisions.detail: QUOTE: If `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on, inits a mutex and calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed, buffer_alloc_free_mutexed)`.
